g.text: Qwen3-VL-2B: what moving the vision tower buys, against moving the decoder
Each LoRA (rank 16) is trained on the readout itself over 2,000 A-OKVQA records, early-stopped on A-OKVQA validation, and then given its own calibration recipe. POPE
and AI2D never appeared in training. A tower-scoped adapter can only change what the model sees; a decoder-scoped one only how it decides.
